entries.zh: 戾：乖戾不公；上位者恣意枉屈加害于人
entries.en: to wrong unjustly (of a superior acting perversely); perverse, oppressive

entries.zh: 戾虐：暴虐；上位者虐待下属
entries.en: cruelty and oppression (of a superior over those below); to tyrannize

entries.zh: 虐：虐待、苛虐；上位者苛征重负、鱼肉属民
entries.en: to oppress, tyrannize (a superior laying burdens on his subjects); to abuse

entries.zh: 虐民：虐害百姓，苛待子民
entries.en: to oppress the people, to mistreat one's subjects (vassals)

entries.zh: 磕着：磕撞冒犯；相互冲撞触犯
entries.en: to offend by collision; to run afoul of (clashing or bumping into one another)

entries.zh: 猖：猖獗肆虐，恣意加害
entries.en: rampant, unrestrained (doing injury without check)

entries.zh: 猖狂：狂暴无理；暴怒行凶、不听分说
entries.en: wild and furious without reason (like one gone mad, refusing to listen); unbridled rage

entries.zh: 控制（旧义挟制）：轻慢抗命，挟制压服于人
entries.en: to domineer, hold in check by coercion (wronging through contempt and disobedience)
entries.notes: 『控制』取17世纪旧义『挟制』，与西文『轻视抗命而加害』的对应依赖推断

entries.zh: 恃顽：倚仗他人庇宠而蛮横加害
entries.en: to wrong presuming on another's favour; wilfully emboldened by patronage

entries.zh: 屈害：冤屈陷害，屈枉害人
entries.en: to wrong and injure; to victimize unjustly

entries.zh: 屈东屈西：东也屈、西也屈，谓到处冤屈众人
entries.en: to wrong everybody (lit. wrong east and wrong west)

entries.zh: 屈：屈枉、冤屈（屈害于人）
entries.en: to wrong, to do an injustice; to bend another unjustly

entries.zh: 狂暴：骄横粗暴，无礼肆虐
entries.en: violent and outrageous (with arrogance, disdainfully)

entries.zh: 触犯：干犯触忤；违约犯法
entries.en: to offend, to violate (breaking one's word or the laws); to transgress

entries.zh: 触怨：因憎恶而触犯，结怨于人
entries.en: to offend out of hatred; to provoke resentment

entries.zh: 触发：撩拨触怒；在下者干犯触怒在上者
entries.en: to provoke, to stir up wrath (the inferior offending the superior)

entries.zh: 侵犯：放肆侵越，干犯冒渎
entries.en: to encroach upon, to infringe (wronging presumptuously); to trespass

entries.zh: 横做：横行妄为，强横行事
entries.en: to act wilfully and violently; to do wrong high-handedly

entries.zh: 冤屈：怀仇冤枉屈害；冤仇
entries.en: to wrong out of enmity; injustice, grievance

entries.zh: 冤枉：冤屈枉害（仇家冤枉于人）
entries.en: to wrong unjustly (as an enemy does); to do injustice

entries.zh: 冤郁：相互冤害，冤仇郁结
entries.en: to wrong and be wronged; pent-up mutual grievance
entries.notes: 西文为相互加害，汉字『冤郁』按『冤仇郁结』义对应，依赖推断

entries.zh: 冤陷：设谋欺诈，诬陷害人
entries.en: to frame and entrap by deceit and scheming
